value.rationale: Unlike ordinary single-horizon placement, this establishes one exact optimal leader configuration family for every positive observation time and all positive inverse spectral orders. The strict integer-gap Schur-convexity is a reusable structural lemma, with quantitative nonzero balancing penalties and exact global maxima/minima for all graph sizes and budgets. The exact optimum census is previously available for the first inverse criterion, while its simultaneous all-time validity follows here. In ring consensus design it resolves whether the optimal placement must be retuned between transient and stationary criteria; it never is under the specified symmetric unit-weight assumptions. Scope is motivated by classical ring leader selection, not an arbitrarily chosen graph parameter.
